reviews.review_text: Being a working professional with 4+ years of experience, enrolling under the NMIMS online EMBA was quite challenging for me, but honestly, it is a completely worth it course for skill development and upliftment.

One of my previous organization's managers told me about the NMIMS online executive MBA for career advancement. I still thank him to date, as now we both are working in the same company, and I got a senior management job role with an 80% hike!
I am totally satisfied with the academic support and education quality offered under the NMIMS online EMBA and highly recommend it to others!!

If you are interested in upskilling without a professional career break, my personal recommendation is the NMIMS online EMBA. It has a perfect balance of every required aspect a working executive asks for. However, consider your preferences too before enrolling, period.

faqs.question: How does the program balance theoretical concepts with practical financial applications?
faqs.answer: With theoretical core modules and industry experience via projects, the program balances theoretical concepts with practical financial applications.

faqs.question: Does NMIMS provide career support specific to the finance course?
faqs.answer: Yes, NMIMS provides career support specific to the finance course and to every other specialization offered at the institution.

faqs.question: Can I pursue this course while working in a demanding finance or audit job?
faqs.answer: This NMIMS online EMBA in applied finance is specially crafted to assist working professionals in acquiring a postgraduate degree without a professional gap or quitting their jobs. It allows you to pursue this course while working in a demanding finance or audit job.

data.placement_content:
The NMIMS online executive MBA is a specially designed online postgraduate degree for working professionals who are currently working and looking for better working opportunities without a career gap. Simultaneously, the students enrolled in this program have an ideal target to enhance their skills and abilities to increase their earning potential and demand fewer employment assistance services.

However, the NMIMS CDOE has provided one-on-one mentorship without any charges under its "Career Development Services" on the alumni portal. It allows enrolled students to build a network and connections with industry professionals and get updated information on job openings.

data.eligibility_content:
Online Executive MBA Eligibility Criteria

Working professionals willing to upgrade their career without a professional gap can pursue the NMIMS online executive MBA course by fulfilling the below-mentioned eligibility criteria:

  • The applicants must have completed a bachelor's degree in any stream from a recognized university/institution.
  • A minimum of 55% marks at graduation is necessary for general category students. However, a 5% relaxation is awarded to students from SC/ST/OBC/PwD.
  • A valid 3+ years of work experience is essential to pursue this degree program.
  • Students who qualify for the above-mentioned eligibility criterion are required to appear for a personal interview, where they must show their zest, aptitude, and leadership potential.
data.admission_steps:
The complete admission process for the NMIMS online executive MBA involves below listed steps:

  1. Registration: Visit the official website of NMIMS CDOE and register.
  2. Application Form: Fill out the application form and pay the required application fee along with it.
  3. Document Submission: Attach the supporting documents along with the application form, including photo identity, academic transcript, passport size photograph, etc.
  4. Personal Interview: Appear for a virtual interview and showcase your motivation for the working executive course with leadership qualities.
  5. Fee Submission: Pay the prescribed course fee and finalize your admission.
  6. Confirmation: Once the university verifies your details, fee payment, and submitted documents, a "student number" is allotted, and your admission process is completed.

data.about_content:
An online executive MBA in applied finance is offered at NMIMS CDOE as an online MBA (WX). The course is designed by a blend of academics and industry experts, equipped with thorough knowledge and understanding of the global finance industry, to add a global perspective to aspiring financial professionals.

The NMIMS online executive MBA in applied finance is equipped with expertise in financial management to successfully thrive in the financial industry. The course is developed to provide an in-depth understanding of security analysis, portfolio management, financial engineering, capital markets, and financial reporting and analysis.

The NMIMS online EMBA prepares professionals to deal with real-world financial management challenges effectively, with the skills and abilities acquired through industry experience and industry projects of the course. To resolve course queries, the NMIMS online EMBA in applied finance has a dedicated student success team for student assistance.

data.exam_content:
The NMIMS online courses examination process is similar for both UG and PG programs. The exams are conducted through an online proctored platform that allows students to appear for the examinations from any corner of the globe; they only need a good internet connection, a laptop, and a working webcam.

The NMIMS online examinations follow an evaluation method of IA + TEE, which stands for Internal Assessment + Term End Examinations.

highlights.highlight_description: The course is designed to transform experienced working professionals into future-proof leaders.
The course curriculum includes intensive academics with modules from Harvard Business Publishing Education (HBPE).
For better interaction and networking opportunities, the course offers an on-campus program immersion.
The NMIMS online executive MBA course has a vast alumni network of 75,000+ professionals.
Students enrolled in the NMIMS online executive MBA can avail of the live lecture recordings within 4 hours.
The learning pedagogy includes a robust library, video transcripts, and full-fledged access to the system through mobile devices/apps.
The NMIMS executive online MBA allows you to opt for a core specialization or dual specialization.
For a hassle-free learning experience, the university provides online and offline tools that resolve every student's query and have a CSAT rate of more than 85%.
It is a 2 year postgraduate degree course with a maximum validity of 4 years.

data.syllabus_content:
The syllabus for the NMIMS online executive MBA in applied finance covers 8 terms, spanning over 2 years. The initial terms have core management courses, whereas the 3/4/5 have elective courses as per the chosen specialization by the student. Term 6 consists of a 3 month capstone project, and terms 7 & 8 include mandatory 6 month industry experience. The detailed NMIMS online executive MBA in applied finance curriculum is listed below.

Term 3 (Core)

  • Managerial Economics
  • Strategic Management

Term 8

  • Project or Industry Experience
